metrics.coreHint: Grows when a promise is confirmed by action or honest review.
metrics.abyssHint: Grows when a commitment stays open or the reason is not backed by facts.

confirms.resetMessage: All data will be erased. This cannot be undone.

noGoal.title: Start with a goal
noGoal.desc: Tonight's review needs a concrete result to check. Create a goal, then build the day from one result and three steps.

noDayPlan.title: Build the day
noDayPlan.desc: Choose one result for today and three steps: understand what matters, apply it, produce something external. You can refine the wording in the cards.

dayClosed.title: Day closed
dayClosed.desc: Fact, lesson, and tomorrow correction saved.

dayOpen.title: Day still needs closing
dayOpen.desc: Close task statuses and run the review.

today.recoveryNote: Recovery is not a reward or a punishment. It keeps the working pace intact.
today.repairConsequence: Correction without punishment: name the cause and choose one smaller step for tomorrow.

dayTaskDefaults.learningDesc: Weekly track context: “{track}”. Name one learning step that fits today.
dayTaskDefaults.practiceDesc: Weekly track context: “{track}”. Name one hands-on application for today—not the whole week.
dayTaskDefaults.outputDesc: Weekly orientation (not today’s whole task): {horizon}. For today, define one measurable external result in one day and edit the task title if needed.

dailyTrajectoryFallback.microGoal: Create one measurable daily step: clarify what is needed, apply it, and ship a small visible result.
dailyTrajectoryFallback.weeklyLink: Weekly goal: {horizon}. Today advances it through one daily result, without repeating the whole week in each task.
dailyTrajectoryFallback.learningDesc: Weekly context: “{track}”. Pick one specific source or lesson—only what the next step requires today.
dailyTrajectoryFallback.practiceDesc: One short action on “{track}” that directly uses what you clarified in learning.
dailyTrajectoryFallback.outputDesc: Produce something outside your head: draft, screenshot, message, post, application—toward “{horizon}”. Something you can show or send.
dailyTrajectoryFallback.clientMicroGoal: Prepare an offer and send 10 quality proposals to potential clients.
dailyTrajectoryFallback.clientWeeklyLink: Weekly goal: {horizon}. Today tests demand: who needs a website, which offer is clear, and where the first reply can appear.
dailyTrajectoryFallback.clientLearningDesc: Weekly context: “{track}”. Define 2–3 client types that may need a simple website now and list their pain points.
dailyTrajectoryFallback.clientPracticeDesc: Write a short commercial proposal: who the site is for, the result you promise, timing, a price anchor, and one clear reply prompt.
dailyTrajectoryFallback.clientOutputDesc: Send 10 quality personalized proposals to potential clients or relevant channels. Weekly goal: {horizon}.
dailyTrajectoryFallback.clientRisk: Getting stuck preparing instead of reaching real people.
dailyTrajectoryFallback.clientMinimumAction: List 5 potential clients and send the first personalized proposal.

today.dayPlanMainSummary: Today: understand what matters, apply it, produce an external result.

nextAction.title: Now
nextAction.outcome: Tonight the result becomes a fact, a lesson, and one correction for tomorrow.

dayPlan.title: Build the day
dayPlan.weekGoalFallback: Weekly outcome is not explicit yet
dayPlan.trajectoryFallback: The daily micro-goal should be closed through the stages below: clarify what is needed, apply it, and ship a visible result.
dayPlan.microGoalPlaceholder: Write one result you can realistically close today?

dailyPlan.title: Run focus
dailyPlan.blockRule: 3 day blocks: one main step and up to two support steps in each.
dailyPlan.note: The three steps point to one result: understand, apply, show externally.
dailyPlan.minimumDay: Minimum day: one main step in morning, day, and evening.

task.stageMicroPlaceholder: In one line: what this stage moves toward for the week…

focus.title: Focus
focus.yandexMusicHint: Yandex Music works as an external player. Open it in a separate page, then return to the timer.
focus.yandexMusicEmpty: No Yandex Music player is selected in profile yet.
focus.yandexMusicInvalid: The saved URL is not a Yandex Music iframe player.
focus.yandexMusicSlow: If Yandex Music did not open, check your account sign-in on music.yandex.ru.
focus.yandexMusicExternalMode: Life OS does not embed Yandex Music in an iframe because the player can break in the browser. Use the built-in background for fully controlled sound.
focus.resultPlaceholder: What was done during the block?
focus.noResultNote: Focus without result doesn't count as progress.
focus.earlyExitIntro: You left before the timer ended. It only counts with a reason and a small repair step.
focus.salvageActionPlaceholder: Example: tomorrow, start with 10 minutes before social feeds
focus.salvageActionHint: This is not punishment. It is the smallest correction for the next run.
focus.accountabilityBody: The block was not completed as promised. Record the fact and return with a smaller next step.
focus.accountabilityDeepIntro: The task is not closed. Record the reason and the next smaller step:
focus.accountabilityDeepQ2: What specifically got in the way?
focus.accountabilityDeepQ3: Was it objective circumstances, or could you have influenced the outcome?
focus.accountabilityDeepQ4: What will you do tomorrow to avoid repeating this?
focus.accountabilityDeepQ5: What’s the smallest step you can take next?
focus.reflectIntro: You had more than two distractions. Answer briefly:
focus.reflectFuture: What will help you avoid this next time?
focus.optionalIntro: If you want, leave a short note (optional): what felt hard, what tried to distract you but didn’t win, or that everything went smoothly.

rest.title: Recovery
rest.subtitle: After a focus block, the brain needs recovery. Choose useful rest.
rest.customPlaceholder: E.g. shower, stretching, tea without screen…
rest.feedbackSubtitle: Rate the effect of the rest
rest.shortRecovery5: Suggested recovery window: about 5 minutes — align rest length with how much attention slipped.
rest.shortRecovery10: Suggested recovery window: about 10 minutes — you lost more signal; give the brain a slightly longer reset.

proof.placeholder: Briefly describe the result or paste a link

profile.title: Profile
profile.resetMessage: All data will be erased. This cannot be undone.
profile.metricsLegend: XP: activity. Reliability: confirmed promises. Risk: open commitments.
profile.stabilizationCardBody: The system limits tasks to restore control.
profile.costHint: Cost depends on the selected model and the provider tariff. Check the provider dashboard for the actual amount.
profile.aiReasonMissingApiKey: OPENROUTER_API_KEY is not set on the server (see .env.example).
profile.aiMentorOfflineHint: Skip API for Today, Day Review, and stabilization mentor text. Goal analysis and day order may still call AI.
profile.soundHint: A short chime and a light haptic tap when the focus timer reaches zero.
profile.focusMusicHint: The default built-in background starts with the timer. Use an external link only for a direct audio file or stream.
profile.focusMusicYandexHint: Yandex Music opens in a separate page. Life OS does not embed it in an iframe because the Yandex player can break in the browser.
profile.focusMusicYandexEndStops: For external Yandex Music, Life OS cannot press play/pause. Control playback on the Yandex page.
profile.focusMusicPreviewHint: The test starts after a click and stops automatically after a few seconds.
profile.focusMusicPreviewFailed: Could not start audio. Choose the built-in background or use a direct audio file URL.
profile.focusMusicUrlHint: Use a direct mp3, ogg, or stream URL. YouTube and Yandex Music page links cannot be paused by this app from the browser.
profile.focusMusicUrlEmpty: Add a direct audio file URL or choose the built-in background.
profile.focusMusicUrlInvalid: The URL must start with http:// or https:// and point to an audio file or stream.
profile.focusMusicUrlPageUnsupported: This is a music-service page link. The browser cannot play and stop it from the app. Use the built-in background or a direct mp3/ogg/stream URL.
profile.taskReminderHint: An in-app reminder appears while the day is not closed and tasks remain.
profile.dataLocal: Day plans, tasks, reviews, and settings are stored in this browser.
profile.dataAi: AI receives only the text needed for the selected prompt. You can complete reviews without AI.
profile.dataReset: You can delete data here with ?Reset data?. Undo is available immediately after reset.
profile.settingsIntro: Settings for mode, data, appearance, and focus sessions.
profile.accountModeHint: The current mode changes the directness of feedback, not your stored data.
profile.strictnessControlHint: Choose a mode, read the consequences, and confirm the change.

strictnessEffects.soft: More support, a smaller next step, and recovery first.
strictnessEffects.standard: Fact, cause, and one concrete adjustment without extra pressure.
strictnessEffects.hard: Direct feedback and stronger accountability without judging the person.
strictnessEffects.owner: Maximum demands on decisions and consequences. Use only as a deliberate choice.

profile.strictnessExplicitConsent: I understand that this mode uses more direct language and choose it deliberately.
profile.progressHint: Working metrics are grouped separately so they do not compete with settings.
profile.aiDataHint: See what stays local and when the app contacts AI.
profile.dataAiWhen: AI receives text only after your action: analyzing a goal, building a day, or requesting mentor guidance.
profile.dataAiPurpose: The text is used to suggest goal wording, an action order, or a review. Profile identity is not required for these requests.
profile.dataAiChoice: Day review and core settings remain available without AI. You can enable mentor offline mode below.
profile.appearanceHint: Theme changes immediately; language keeps the current section.
profile.focusSectionHint: Timer completion sound and optional focus background.
profile.remindersHint: Local reminders for unfinished tasks in the current day.
profile.dangerHint: Reset deletes local goals, plans, reviews, and settings. A short undo window is available immediately after reset.

goals.title: Goals
goals.onlyOneGoal: In MVP, one active goal is available. Complete the current one to create a new one.
goals.noGoalDesc: Start with one external result for the next 7 calendar days.
goals.monthSectionHint: Optional. Connects several weeks, but is not required to build your first day.
goals.weekSectionHint: One external result for the next 7 days. Life OS will use it to build today.

goalCard.daysUntilDeadline: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} until deadline
goalCard.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} overdue

goalBuilder.step1Desc: Write the goal in plain language. If it sounds like learning or preparation, the system will reframe it as an external result.
goalBuilder.placeholder: E.g.: I want to learn UX/UI, build websites, earn from design…
goalBuilder.smartIntro: You can still write one paragraph above—this is a quick checklist before you continue.
goalBuilder.smartS: Specific: what you’ll deliver, in what form, for whom if it matters.
goalBuilder.smartM: Measurable: how you’ll know it’s done—a number, artifact, link, calendar checkpoint.
goalBuilder.smartA: Achievable: fits your level and horizon; not “everything at once”.
goalBuilder.smartR: Relevant: why this matters to you right now.
goalBuilder.smartT: Time-bound: by when or within how many days—without a date intent drifts.
goalBuilder.step1NextHint: Describe your goal in more detail: what you want, why, and roughly by when (think ~2 sentences, 7+ meaningful words). Use SMART as a checklist.
goalBuilder.errorShort: Add a concrete result, context, and approximate timing—at least 7 meaningful words and 45 characters.
goalBuilder.errorAnalysis: We couldn’t analyze the goal. Your text is still here—try again.
goalBuilder.errorActiveExists: There is already an active goal for this horizon. Complete or archive it before creating a new one.
goalBuilder.step2Desc: This helps the system give a precise breakdown
goalBuilder.doneSoFarLabel: What have you already done by hand?
goalBuilder.doneSoFarPlaceholder: E.g.: watched 2 lessons, made a draft…
goalBuilder.blockerLabel: What's stopping you from taking action now?
goalBuilder.blockerPlaceholder: E.g.: don't know where to start, afraid to show the result…
goalBuilder.step3Desc: Check that the result, first step, and deadline agree.
goalBuilder.contextHint: Helps tailor the first step. You can skip this.
goalBuilder.weeklyInputTitle: What result do you need in 7 days?
goalBuilder.monthlyInputTitle: What direction do you need for the next 3–5 weeks?
goalBuilder.weeklyInputDesc: Describe one result that can be shown, sent, or verified.
goalBuilder.monthlyInputDesc: This direction connects several weeks but is not required to build today.
goalBuilder.weeklyInputHelp: State what should be ready, for whom, and roughly by when.
goalBuilder.monthlyInputHelp: Describe a larger external result. You can skip the additional context.
goalBuilder.weeklyPlaceholder: For example: publish a first landing page and get feedback from three people
goalBuilder.monthlyPlaceholder: For example: launch the first product version and collect five substantive reviews
goalBuilder.requirementsProgress: Minimum {minWords} words and {minCharacters} characters. Now: {words} words · {characters} characters.
goalBuilder.defaultWhy: The user wants to turn the goal into a concrete external result.

analysisCard.focusHint: Deadline and steps are shared. Realism is scored for the wording you select.
analysisCard.externalLinked: First daily step: {step}. Expected external result: {base}
analysisCard.inDays: {days, plural, one {# calendar day} other {# calendar days}}, including today
analysisCard.firstStepSectionHint: Tied to the goal you selected (original or working). Replace with your own wording—the outcome below will update.
analysisCard.firstStepPlaceholder: Describe the first action you can take today…
analysisCard.note: Learning without applying doesn't close a goal. The next step must leave a mark in reality: a project, publication, application, feedback, or measurable result.

court.title: Day Review
court.noOrderDesc: Build the day first so there is something to review tonight.
court.proofRequiredBeforeCompleted: Add proof in the task before counting it as done
court.previewHasFailed: Reason review can change the outcome.
court.previewNoFailed: Proceed to review to confirm the outcome.

verdict.title: Review saved

verdictBrief.self_victory: Tasks closed: {done} of {total}. Key outcome achieved — logged as a win.
verdictBrief.recovered_victory: Recovery after an unclosed task was counted, so a recovered victory is recorded.
verdictBrief.partial_victory: Progress ({done} of {total}), but not the full plan ({partial} partial, {failed} missed). Verdict: partial victory.
verdictBrief.respectful_transfer: Reasons are accepted as valid: the day is not a full success, but the commitment is transferred without an open item.
verdictBrief.failure: Task outcome is below plan ({done} done, {partial} partial, {failed} not closed). A correction is needed for the next run.
verdictBrief.self_deception: The minimum step was possible but not done. The outcome strengthens the system correction, not a judgment of character.

verdict.weeklyOrientAsideHint: Separate from today’s micro-goals — what the week-long aim is.

nextStep.continue: Keep the same cadence toward the goal.
nextStep.tomorrow: Move the remainder to tomorrow and define one minimal step.
nextStep.split: Split what’s left into smaller moves and start with one.
nextStep.recovery: Do recovery: focus block or recovery quest.
nextStep.capture_reason: Capture the reason and pick one minimal honest step.

verdict.recoveryHintMinutes: After reflection, a short recovery is optional: {minutes} minutes phone-off.
verdict.abyssLegend: Risk: a rising index means the day needs a simpler setup.
verdict.selfDeceptionNote: Fact: the minimum action was possible but not performed. This is a system-correction signal, not a character judgment.
verdict.transferNote: The reason was accepted as valid. No open commitment was created, but the commitment was transferred.
verdict.failureNote: The promise was not kept. A concrete correction is needed for the next run.
verdict.debtNote: Close it with a recovery quest.
verdict.stabilizationNote: Control dropped. The system limits tasks and returns to the baseline.
verdict.abyssWarning: Warning: high risk index ({pct}%). One more unclosed day activates stabilization.

riskChange.increased: Risk increased by {value} pp: a commitment remains open or the reason needs confirmation.
riskChange.decreased: Risk decreased by {value} pp: the commitment was confirmed by action or an honest review.
riskChange.unchanged: Risk did not change in this review.

reviewHistory.title: Review history
reviewHistory.subtitle: Day by day: outcome, causes, tasks, metric changes, and the correction for the next run.
reviewHistory.summaryTitle: What is happening in the system
reviewHistory.emptyAll: After the first saved review, this page will show the day outcome, causes, tasks, and recovery.
reviewHistory.emptyPeriod: There are no saved reviews in the selected period.
reviewHistory.notFoundText: The record may have been removed from this device's local storage.
reviewHistory.legacyMentorNote: The original mentor message was not stored for this older record. The remaining data comes from the saved review.

failureReview.title: Reason review
failureReview.honesty: Facts matter more than a polished report. If the minimum step was possible, record it.
failureReview.whyFailed: Why was the task not completed?
failureReview.repairActionPlaceholder: One concrete step: when, what, and how much smaller
failureReview.falseRest: There was false rest (scrolling, video, social media instead of real rest)
failureReview.reasonRequiredHint: A reason is required only for partial and unfinished tasks.
failureReview.reasonMissing: Choose a reason and leave one concrete correction for the next attempt.

stabilization.title: Stabilization Mode
stabilization.subtitle: Control lost. The system restricts tasks and restores the baseline level.
stabilization.mainTaskNote: In stabilization mode — only one task. No more.
stabilization.canReturn: You can return to normal mode.
stabilization.conditionQuests: At least one recovery quest completed

result.title: One result, then you can begin.
result.description: Describe what needs to be ready. Life OS will suggest a weekly goal and three short steps for today.
result.label: What result do you want to achieve?
result.placeholder: For example: prepare and send the client a proposal draft
result.hint: Use your own words. You can edit the result and steps later.
result.required: Describe one result to build your day.

review.title: Your first day is ready.
review.description: Review the plan. After you accept, focus opens on the first step.

rules.0: Close the day with evidence of action.
rules.1: If it did not work, record the reason and reduce the next step.
rules.2: The review adjusts the next day; it does not judge you.

review.cta: Accept the rules and open focus
review.saveError: Couldn’t save the day. Your input is still here—try again.
